details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The narrative progresses from overall performance to revenue breakdown, profitability metrics, cash flow, balance sheet changes, and operational updates. Explanations for changes (e.g., project handovers, fair-value gains, impairment) are provided where relevant. There is no unnecessary repetition, and related information is grouped appropriately (e.g., revenue sections, profitability sections, operational updates). While segment figures aren't explicitly reconciled to consolidated totals, the candidate never claims they should sum directly, so this isn't an internal contradiction. The summary forms a clear, logical whole.
